heroSub: Scope: the 543 /th-th/content/ pages from the supplied sitemap, rendered one at a time. Block counts are lower bounds: the site is a client-rendered AEM app and the block detector was improved mid-run, so some pages (notably offers) are under-captured. Live-site issues found: broken Special Offers redirect, search page never loads, 3 app pages under maintenance, expired offers redirecting to the homepage.
